name: Lehar Footwears Limited
about: Lehar Footwears Limited manufactures and sells footwear under the LEHAR brand in India and internationally. It offers men's and ladies' footwear, casual footwear, flip flops, kid sandals, ladies' and men's slippers, ladies' fashion and women's footwear, ladies sandals, sports shoes, men's sandals, school shoes, canvas shoes, EVA footwear, men's loafer shoes, and moccasins. The company was formerly known as Lawreshwar Polymers Limited and changed its name to Lehar Footwears Limited in October 2019. Lehar Footwears Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Jaipur, India.
